title: Peak net L5/S1 moment lifting 10 kg from ankle height with free, squat and stoop technique, no exoskeleton

quantity.name: peak L5S1 net flexion-extension moment (ML5S1_total)
quantity.definition: bottom-up inverse dynamics, peak over lift, mean ± SD (error bars assumed SD)

source.authors: Koopman AS, Näf M, Baltrusch SJ, Kingma I, Rodriguez-Guerrero C, Babič J, de Looze MP, van Dieën JH

protocol.summary: Lifting a 10 kg box with handles 10 cm above ankle height (horizontal distance not stated) using three techniques: Free (self-selected), Squat (knees flexed, trunk upright), Stoop (trunk bent, knees extended); cycle = pick up, return upright holding box, replace, return upright; 3 reps each; self-selected speed; WITHOUT exoskeleton only. Peak values.
how_to_simulate: Scale model to a 175 cm, 83.6 kg male
Simulate 10 kg box lifts from 10 cm above ankle height, Free/Squat/Stoop
Compare peak net L5-S1 extension moment

subject_model.source: Koopman 2020b Methods 2.2 (mean of 10 males; 1.75 ± 0.07 m, 83.6 ± 16.2 kg)

protocol.notes: WITHOUT digitised (Fig. 4): peak lumbar flexion Free 56.5±7.5, Squat 53.7±6.1, Stoop 63.5±8.9 deg; peak trunk angular velocity Free 209±51, Squat 184±25, Stoop 177±34 deg/s.
